name: radio-card
title: Radio Card
description: A composable radio input styled as a card. Compose with Title, Description, Content, Indicator, KeyIcon, and Badge sub-components.

docs.lead: A composable radio input styled as a card. Arrange titles, descriptions, icons, and badges however you want.
docs.usage:
import * as RadioCard from "@/components/ui/radio-card"

<RadioCard.Root value={value} onValueChange={setValue}>
  <RadioCard.Item value="opt1">
    <RadioCard.Content>
      <RadioCard.Title>Option 1</RadioCard.Title>
      <RadioCard.Description>Description</RadioCard.Description>
    </RadioCard.Content>
    <RadioCard.Indicator />
  </RadioCard.Item>
</RadioCard.Root>

api.name: RadioCard.Root
api.description: The root container wrapping Radix RadioGroup.Root.

props.name: hasError
props.description: Error state — changes ring and focus shadow to error colors

props.name: allowDeselect
props.description: Allow clicking a selected card to deselect it

api.name: RadioCard.Item
api.description: A card container. Renders a label element. Place Content, icons, badges, and Indicator as children.

props.name: value
props.description: The radio value for this card

api.name: RadioCard.Content
api.description: Flex wrapper for title and description. Takes flex-1 to fill available space.

props.name: inline
props.description: When true, renders children in a row (inline) instead of a column

api.name: RadioCard.Title
api.description: Styled title text. Renders a span element.

api.name: RadioCard.Description
api.description: Styled description text. Renders a p element.

api.name: RadioCard.Indicator
api.description: The radio circle indicator. Reads value and disabled from the parent Item context.
